english.title: Cartel offence - Enterprise Act 2002
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) dishonestly agreed with one or more persons to

(A)_[make or implement]_
(B)_[cause to be made or implemented]_

arrangements relating to at least two undertakings which, if operating as the parties to the agreement had intended, would

(C)_[directly or indirectly fix a price for the supply by one of those undertakings in the United Kingdom of a product or service, namely **(..SPECIFY PRODUCT OR SERVICE..)]_
(D)_[limit or prevent supply by one of those undertakings in the United Kingdom of a product or service, namely **(..SPECIFY PRODUCT OR SERVICE..)]_
(E)_[limit or prevent production by one of those undertakings in the United Kingdom of a product, namely **(..SPECIFY PRODUCT..)]_

english.legislation: Contrary to sections 188 and 190 of the Enterprise Act 2002.

investigatoraction.description: DNA Samples: If crime scene stain present - take evidential sample If no crime scene stain and DNA not confirmed on PNC - take Criminal Justice sample. If DNA confirmed on PNC - CJ sample not required
Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

english.notes:
(i) Section 188 of the Enterprise Act 2002 must be read as a whole, along with section 189 which contains supplementary provisions, when considering a prosecution for this offence.
(ii) In England and Wales an offence under section 188 of the Enterprise Act 2002 may be instituted only (a) by the Director of the Serious Fraud Office, or (b) by or with the consent of the OFT.

other.penalty:
Summary: A fine not exceeding the statutory maximum.
Indictment: Five years Imprisonment and /or a fine.

Time limit for prosecutions:
None

On the 12th March 2015 the limit on fines imposed by a Magistrates’ court was removed – as such, the potential fine on summary conviction in relation to an offence committed after this date is unlimited.
